title: EBSD Crystallographic and Microstructure Characterization of Laser 3D-Printed Lunar Regolith Simulants for Off-World Construction
content: NASA’s Moon-to-Mars Planetary Autonomous Construction Technology (MMPACT) project is developing autonomous infrastructure solutions to support long-term lunar exploration under the Artemis Program. A key focus is in-situ resource utilization (ISRU), which aims to construct landing pads, roads, and shelters using lunar regolith as a feedstock. However, lunar construction presents challenges, including extreme cold, radiation exposure, microgravity, and limited resources. Additionally, the abrasive, heterogeneous nature of regolith poses risks to equipment and infrastructure durability.
